author: TASS
title: Russia's Battlegroup South thwarts Ukraine's attempt to rotate troops in Konstantinovka
text:
MOSCOW, June 25. /TASS/. Drone operators of Russia’s Battlegroup South thwarted the rotation of Ukrainian troops near Konstantinovka, the Russian Defense Ministry said.
"In the course of combat operations, reconnaissance of the 6th motorized rifle division detected an enemy convoy approaching the town of Konstantinovka. An enemy car was transporting personnel. The target’s coordinates were relayed to the FPV drone operator. A direct hit destroyed the enemy vehicle along with its personnel. In doing so, the FPV drone operator thwarted the enemy’s objectives, depriving it of its transport and infantry support," the ministry said.
Apart from that, another enemy car was spotted and destroyed by a FPV drone. "The enemy’s plans were foiled. The enemy is unable to ensure support for its infantry. Any attempt at deploying manpower or delivering cargoes is futile," it added.
